BREAKDOWNS.incident_title: Blower Motor Overheating and V-Belt Slip
BREAKDOWNS.symptoms: Blower vibration exceeds 4.5 mm/s RMS, bearing housing temperature reached 85°C.
BREAKDOWNS.corrective_action: Isolate drive supply, replace SPA-1250 matched V-belt set, and laser-align motor sheave.
BREAKDOWNS.notes: Spares requisitioned from Rack P-04; bearing housing cooled and under alignment check.

BREAKDOWNS.incident_title: Mechanical Seal Gland Weeping & Pressure Drop
BREAKDOWNS.symptoms: Slurry weeping from primary seal gland; discharge line pressure dropped by 1.2 bar.
BREAKDOWNS.corrective_action: Install new 45mm silicon carbide mechanical seal ring and pressure-test casing.
BREAKDOWNS.notes: Silicon carbide seal ring issued from Bin M-12. Reassembly in progress.

BREAKDOWNS.symptoms: Intermittent false bottle jam trips at starwheel transfer.
BREAKDOWNS.corrective_action: Replaced 24VDC opto-electronic sensor bracket and recalibrated starwheel timing.
BREAKDOWNS.notes: Line restored to 240 vials/min nominal throughput.

rca.primary_root_cause: Bracket vibration loosening from washdown thermal cycling
rca.why1: Infeed starwheel tripped on false vial jam
rca.why3: Mounting locknut backed off during high-pressure washdown
rca.corrective: Installed Nyloc locking hardware and calibrated sensor gain
rca.preventive: Added weekly torque verification to Pharma Filler PM checklist

BREAKDOWNS.symptoms: Drum water level hunting between low-water alarm and normal band.
BREAKDOWNS.corrective_action: Replaced pneumatic positioner diaphragm and recalibrated 4-20mA control loop.
BREAKDOWNS.notes: Steam header pressure stabilized at 8.5 bar.

rca.primary_root_cause: Instrument air moisture condensation in positioner diaphragm
rca.why2: Positioner diaphragm stiffness and moisture ingress
rca.why3: Air dryer auto-drain trap on utility header was partially blocked
rca.corrective: Cleaned auto-drain trap and replaced positioner diaphragm kit
rca.preventive: Scheduled daily condensate blowdown check on boiler instrument air receiver

BREAKDOWNS.incident_title: Thermoforming Heater Solid State Relay Trip
BREAKDOWNS.symptoms: Upper forming platen zone 2 temperature dropped 18°C below setpoint.
BREAKDOWNS.corrective_action: Replaced 40A 240VAC solid state relay with thermal paste on heatsink.
BREAKDOWNS.notes: Forming web index verified and QA blister seal test passed.

rca.primary_root_cause: Thermal paste degradation on SSR heatsink mount
rca.why1: Zone 2 heater platen lost heating power
rca.why3: Cabinet cooling fan filter dust buildup raised ambient temperature
rca.corrective: Replaced SSR and cleaned cabinet intake filter
rca.preventive: Monthly control cabinet filter inspection added

BREAKDOWNS.incident_title: Exhaust Filter Bag Shaking Cylinder Leak
BREAKDOWNS.symptoms: Differential pressure across exhaust bag filter remained high during pulse cycle.
BREAKDOWNS.corrective_action: Replaced pneumatic shaking cylinder rod seal and regulated air supply to 6.0 bar.
BREAKDOWNS.notes: Filter differential pressure restored to normal operating band.

rca.primary_root_cause: Rod wiper seal wear from fine granulation dust
rca.why1: Shaking cylinder failed to stroke fully
rca.why3: Rod wiper seal worn by fine powder ingress
rca.corrective: Installed DNC-40-100-PPV cylinder with Viton dust boot
rca.preventive: Bi-monthly pneumatic cylinder stroke and seal inspection

record.title: Opsloom AI: DIAGNOSE FLEET

sections.heading: AI Engineering Synthesis
items: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:

Opsloom Kenya is currently operating at compromised capacity with two high-priority breakdowns and a growing maintenance backlog. Immediate intervention is required on the Granulation Fluid Bed Dryer (FBD-01) and Centrifugal Slurry Pump (CP-04) to prevent cascading system failures and secondary motor damage.
KEY TELEMETRY FINDINGS:

• **Thermal & Mechanical Degradation (FBD-01):** Critical overheating in the blower motor is directly correlated with V-belt slippage, leading to inefficient torque transfer and reduced airflow in the granulation process.

• **Fluid Containment Loss (CP-04):** Active gland weeping at the mechanical seal has resulted in a measurable discharge pressure drop, signaling imminent seal failure and potential slurry contamination of the bearing housing.

• **Reliability Backlog Stress:** With 16.6% of the fleet in breakdown status and 33% of upcoming tasks overdue, the plant's reliability margin is currently below the acceptable engineering threshold.
RECOMMENDED ENGINEERING ACTIONS:

1. **Immediate Overhaul of FBD-01 Drive Train:** Perform Lockout-Tagout (LOTO) to replace the worn V-belts, check pulley alignment using laser tools, and conduct an insulation resistance test (Megger) on the motor to assess thermal damage.

2. **Seal Integrity Restoration for CP-04:** Deploy a mechanical seal replacement kit immediately; simultaneously verify if the required seal or gland packing is among the 4 low-stock items to ensure zero-delay procurement.

AI_CHATS.title: Opsloom AI: SPARE REPLENISHMENT

sections.heading: AI Engineering Synthesis
items: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:

Immediate procurement is required for four critical low-stock items and specific components for two active breakdowns to restore plant reliability and address an overdue maintenance task. Priorities include drive components for the Granulation Fluid Bed Dryer and sealing kits for the Centrifugal Slurry Pump.
KEY TELEMETRY FINDINGS:
• Critical inventory alert: 4 essential spare parts have fallen below safety stock thresholds, threatening the execution of upcoming maintenance.
• FBD-01 breakdown diagnostics indicate a requirement for replacement V-belts and motor bearing lubricants to address slippage and thermal escalation.
• CP-04 telemetry shows a loss of containment at the gland, necessitating a full mechanical seal assembly replacement to resolve pressure drop issues.
RECOMMENDED ENGINEERING ACTIONS:
1. Initiate emergency procurement for matched V-belt sets for FBD-01 and high-abrasion resistant mechanical seal kits for CP-04 to resolve current downtime.
2. Conduct an inventory replenishment cycle for the 4 low-stock items and verify part availability for the overdue maintenance task to prevent further scheduling backlogs.
